title: MISSING - one nine men's morris piece, last seen shrinking. The executions in my pixel art board game do not always leave a body.
text: Millfall is nine men's morris where closing a mill lets one of your pieces execute one of theirs, and shrink is one of the 33 execution techniques. ULFRIC was standing on the inner ring in Moss Grove when Dusk closed a mill, and the four sightings on the poster are frames from that execution. Every frame here is rendered straight out of the game. The notice board is not.

title: The Star Shrine Standoff - 11 fell, 139 moves, nobody won: the battle tapestry Millfall weaves for a nine men's morris draw
text: Millfall's AI played both sides in the Star Shrine arena: 139 moves, 11 pieces destroyed, Dawn 5 executions to Dusk 6, and it still ended in a draw with both sides left standing. Every finished match is woven into this tapestry straight from the game's own log - a woodcut card for each fall, the cause of death spelled out, the last one enthroned in the middle. One piece left the board as a frog. Pixel art, abstract strategy, and a chronicle nobody asked for.
